name: Plane
description: A small light plane (a Cessna 172S's numbers) on tricycle gear with a high wing: slow, gentle and easy to land. One pilot seat for now.
comment: A vehicle preset (#728, the flight port; #379 made it a light plane): see sedan.json for the format. movementType plane is the Plane movement type, which builds no engine, clutch or transmission: the wheels are undriven landing gear and the aerofoils and the thruster fly it. The engine and transmission under defaults are inert, there only because a vehicle document requires them, and so is the mains axle's drive flag. layout.axles is tricycle gear: axle 0 is one steered wheel on the centerline, axle 1 the pair of mains. chassis.body is the fuselage and body.x says where its middle is. chassis.aircraft is the rest of the airframe, model space, cm, +X forward: wing, tailplane and fin each give their span (the fin its height), chord, x (the quarter-chord line, where its bone hinges and its lift acts), z (not the fin), the area in m^2 (the wing's halves together), camber, largest control angle, stall angle (5 to 30 degrees: lift peaks there, then drops sharply) and an optional maxLift (the peak lift coefficient; absent: the wing 1.5, the others 1.2); the aspect ratio the vehicle document gets is span / chord. engines: count (1 or 2), thrust (N at full throttle: a propeller's static push, a jet's dry thrust), power (kW: a propeller, whose push falls off as 0.8 x power / speed; absent: a jet), afterburnerThrust (a jet's, on the throttle's last tenth) and the hub's x; spoolTime a jet's seconds from idle to full; propeller its radius and rpm; airSpeedLimit a safety cap; controls where the pilot's hands hold. assists (absent: both on) are stallProtection (the player's nose-up input fades as the wing nears its stall) and coordinatedTurns (rudder against sideslip). Numbers from the Cessna 172S handbook: 1,157 kg at take-off with a 75 kg pilot (the preset is 1,082), a 16.2 m^2 wing of span 11.0 m (aspect ratio 7.5), peak lift 1.6 at 16 degrees for its 53-knot clean stall. power is 91 kW, not the engine's 134: a fixed-pitch propeller turns only about 0.54 of it into push, and 91 x 0.8 lands both the 730 ft/min climb and the 126-knot top speed. Static thrust 2.1 kN: the flight probe's 1.8 capped the push at the 74-knot best-climb speed below the power's and climbed 579 ft/min. The airframe's proportions are this preset's estimate: the wing sits on the fuselage's top. Ailerons tuned to about 60 degrees a second (the owner's pick). cruiseSpeed and cruiseThrottle are the trim schema/validate.py and FMantleChassisDerive solve (FMantleFlightModel), and cruiseThrottle is what the pilot's throttle returns to when W and S are let go in the air.
